status: Phase 5 definitions; timing calibration deferred to Phase 6
primary_reliability: Failed independent sentinel reads / completed independent sentinel reads in a declared half-open scenario window, assigned by request start
success: HTTP 200, valid JSON object and expected sentinel content
window: Required explicit start/end, anchor and pair_key; never inferred from treatment duration. Runtime faults use independently verified activation. Other cases use declared launch-relative structure. Historical selections are diagnostic, not prospective declarations.
request_boundary: Include starts in [start,end); a completed request may finish beyond end. Unfinished requests are unknown, not successes. Historical BDI starts reconstructed from completion minus monotonic duration are estimates.
availability: Sample-and-hold between consecutive samples only when gap <= explicitly declared maximum; clip to window. Unbounded edges and measurement failures are unknown. Ratio is healthy seconds / full window, published only if declared minimum coverage passes. Not exact uptime.
recovery: First stable independent healthy sequence after an attributed fault episode; expose onset and confirmation. Later relapse retained. Service restoration does not establish controller causality.
cost: Candidate launch after preflight to native terminal outcome; excludes qualification, setup, collection, post-terminal observation and reset. Native controller runtime is separate. Historical launch proxies explicitly labelled.
attribution: Candidate identity and campaign must match. Read only explicit candidate streams and correlated run IDs. Native detections require native evidence. Reset/qualification/setup cannot be candidate inputs.
missing: null with validity reasons; no imputed zero, success or detection
outcome: Native result immutable. Measurement failure affects metric validity only.
aggregation: Case-weighted summaries and distributions separately from pooled request-weighted error. Report applicability, missingness, censoring, complete pairs, group identity and denominators. No composite score.
limitations: Sentinel-read reliability, not all application behaviour
Independent requests contribute to BDI proxy telemetry; no new queries or traffic
UTC clocks are not proven synchronized
Conventional reseeds; BDI preserves data: unresolved isolation decision before scenario/batch freeze
New native instrumentation requires separately reviewed immutable control publication before live use
